summary: Phase S2 is accepted at baseline 097545f1: all five Story S2 criteria are satisfied by the normative v3/v3.1/v3.2 implementation and deterministic evidence, the correctness, boundary, and API reviews pass without blockers or contract violations, provenance remains auditable, and no engine-package drift follows the accepted baseline.
nonblocking_findings: S2-ACCEPTANCE-001 [low]: The deterministic FSRS fitter emits a complete versioned FSRSParameters artifact and requires explicit human approval, while its bounded optimizer intentionally remains a replaceable two-weight deterministic proxy rather than a broad high-dimensional search.

S2-ACCEPTANCE-002 [low]: Package README migration examples, inherited public-declaration JSDoc debt, and the historical Phase S1 exact export-key snapshot remain Phase S4 documentation/governance work; all current runtime and declaration targets exist, build, and load.

S2-ACCEPTANCE-003 [low]: Frozen source-repository harness assertions in knowledge-space-core and practice-core remain classified nonportable baselines and introduced no new semantic failure in Phase S2.
evidence: Story S2 criterion 1: gated weighted readiness enforces hard prerequisites without compensating through an unmet hard gate; the original normative and focused remediation suites exercise the counterexample deterministically.
Story S2 criterion 2: objective proficiency consumes elapsed-time retention and the minimum live retention across reviewed variants, with attempt caps derived from the least-supported variant.

Story S2 criterion 3: placement, calibration, reveal/severity evidence, timing, and queue behavior reproduce the versioned v3/v3.1/v3.2 examples deterministically. Focused totals are original normative 54/54, public/boundary remediation 53/53, complete SRS 303/303, placement 133/133, and import/export contract 13/13.

Story S2 criterion 4: sparse-domain planning uses readyThreshold and the registered utility provider without synthetic prerequisite edges; the 0.79 versus 0.80 adversarial example proves exclusion, and utility/evaluation artifacts record versioned provenance. The complete knowledge-space-practice evidence is 421/421.

Story S2 criterion 5: due-load composition caps remediation and ordinary review work, preserves remediation-only queues, applies deterministic backlog ordering, diversity and interleaving, and incorporates review-load projections. Commit 097545f1 closes the final remediation-only queue path.

Normative provenance remains explicit in import-provenance.json: same-owner source commit 3e0b3517c42cfe0b603295a1ec48548505617169, kst-srs.v2 normative repository, four frozen source trees, 199-path one-to-one inventory, mechanically equivalent transformation record, and zero unexplained behavior-bearing deviations.

Reviewer A correctness, Reviewer B boundaries, and Reviewer C API/package audits all report pass with empty blocking, test-strategy, live-contract, production-wiring, and route-parity violation arrays.

Baseline inspection resolves 097545f1 to 097545f14a8029d0c3451e3514841f9c5bf3e1c2 and finds no later changes in packages/knowledge-space-core, packages/knowledge-space-practice, packages/srs-engine, or packages/practice-core.
UX review is not applicable because Phase S2 changes framework-neutral engine packages and exposes no browser UI, route, or user interaction surface.
commands: git show -s --format='%H %s' 097545f1; git diff --name-only 097545f1..HEAD -- packages/knowledge-space-core packages/knowledge-space-practice packages/srs-engine packages/practice-core (pass: accepted baseline identified and no post-baseline engine drift)

jq status and violation-array inspection for phase-s2-review-correctness.json, phase-s2-review-boundaries.json, and phase-s2-review-api.json (pass: three pass verdicts and no blocking or contract violations)
jq inspection of import-provenance.json (pass: source, specification, ownership, inventory, equivalence, and deviations are auditable)
Retained Phase S2 evidence: original normative 54/54; public/boundary remediation 53/53; SRS 303/303; knowledge-space-practice 421/421; placement 133/133; import/export contract 13/13
